Looking at the validator errors, my previous attempt only contained the Markdown *embed* wrapper — it never contained an actual FigDown source document. I need to author the real `.fd` file (the block diagram itself), then embed its resulting SVG in Markdown separately. Here is the corrected `.fd` source:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob "timer"
renewaljob -> caclient "obtain cert"
caclient -> ca "issue cert"
renewaljob -> deployagent "cert ready"
deployagent -> service "restart"
```

This is the file to save as `figures/cert-renewal.fd`, then build it (`node build-svg.js figures/cert-renewal.fd`) to produce `figures/cert-renewal.svg`, and embed with the standard footer:

```markdown
![Certificate renewal automation: a scheduler triggers a renewal job, which obtains a new certificate via a CA client from the certificate authority, then hands off to a deploy agent that restarts the service.](figures/cert-renewal.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/cert-renewal.fd](figures/cert-renewal.fd)</sub>
```
